name: Nurix Therapeutics, Inc.
summary:
Nurix Therapeutics, Inc. (NRIX) reported earnings of $4.73 per share on revenue of $673.06 million for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.56 per share on revenue of $139.32 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 944.64% while revenue grew 8,426.27% on a year-over-year basis.

Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development and commercialization of small molecule and cell therapies based on the modulation of cellular protein levels as a novel treatment approach for cancer and other challenging diseases.
subject: Nurix Therapeutics, Inc. Beat Consensus Estimates
